title: feat(studio): Update Records offers the triggering record as its target, starts on the trigger object, and picks keys by label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgYasXP9zbXNbMbiznwvWRvt)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 流程设计器的「更新记录」节点三处改进。在记录触发的流程里新建这个节点时，对象自动填成触发对象；筛选区在没有条目时多了「更新触发记录」按钮，一按就写好「id = record.id（CEL 表达式）」并显示「更新启动此流程的那条某对象记录」；筛选和字段值的键改成按字段标签选，存的仍是 API 名。
- 为什么改：浏览器走查发现作者得自己知道要手打 `id` 加表达式 `record.id`，对象也不预填，键是自由文本（#27521 第 27 行建议半；缺陷半 #27799 已落地）。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端；已有节点打开时一个字节都不写，作者自己写的筛选不动、也不再出现按钮；写入的形状就是 spec 对 CRUD 节点的官方建议形状，测试里用真实的 `FlowSchema` 和 `@objectstack/lint` 发布判决验过；其他节点类型（新建记录、删除记录、查询记录等）不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`（`TriggeringRecordTarget`、`FIELD_VALUE_MAPS`）、`FlowKeyValueField.tsx`（`keysByLabel` 键选择器）、`previews/flow-canvas-parts.tsx`（`defaultNodeExtras` 的 update_record 种子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.updateRecordTarget-27834.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.updateRecordSeed-27834.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 13 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27834

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**Measured first, on `main` at `e6553619`.** The Update Records node is drawn by `FlowNodeConfigField` from the offline descriptor (`flow-node-config.ts`, `update_record`: Object, Filter, Field values) or the engine's `configSchema`. A new node is seeded by `defaultNodeExtras` (`previews/flow-canvas-parts.tsx`), which seeded nothing for `update_record`. Field values already listed the object's fields as datalist suggestions under a free-text key (objectui#11788); Filter keys had none. The spec's own guidance for a CRUD node's target row (`UpdateRecordConfigSchema`, `recordId` guidance) is `filter: { id: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' } }`, and `flow-scope.ts` already scopes the trigger record as `record` at every node the start reaches.

1. **The object starts on the trigger's.** `defaultNodeExtras(type, nodes?)` takes the draft the node joins; for `update_record` on a flow whose start node is a record trigger with an object, the new node is `{ config: { objectName } }`. `FlowCanvas.addNode` and `insertOnEdge` pass their nodes. The trigger-type set is the one `resolveFlowScope` reads, through a new `recordTriggerObjectName` in `flow-scope.ts`. Seeded at creation only: opening a node writes nothing.
2. **"Update the triggering record".** Above an `update_record` Filter, when the trigger record is in scope at the node (`triggerScope`, from `useFlowScope`) and the node's object is the trigger's: on an empty filter a button writes the id match above (`writeValueEnvelope`, no syntax of this surface's own) with a hint naming the object; on a filter that is exactly that match, a line says the node updates the record that started the flow. Any other filter is the author's and is left alone; the button comes back once its rows are removed. The row it writes is an ordinary filter row (`id`, value as a CEL expression), so the existing value-slot checks and Problems list judge it as before.
3. **Keys by label.** `FlowKeyValueField` gains `keysByLabel`: while there are key options, the key cell is the searchable `InspectorComboField`, which shows a field by its label (API name beside it in the list) and stores the API name; a key the catalog does not hold is still taken through its "Use …" row, and a stored unknown key shows as written. With no options (no object, or fields not read) the key stays the plain box. `FIELD_VALUE_MAPS` turns it on for `update_record` `fields` and `filter` (whose keys are fields of the same object). `create_record` keeps the suggested text box, as the order's "other node types unchanged" asks.

i18n: three keys added to the studio namespace (`engine.inspector.flowNode.triggeringRecord.*`, en and zh); no en value changed (`check:i18n-drift`: 0).

## Tests

- New `inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.updateRecordTarget-27834.test.tsx` (9 cases, the real `FlowNodeInspector`): one press writes the id match, the line replaces the button, a Status value picked by label completes the node, and the saved flow passes the publish verdict, computed with the real `FlowSchema` plus `validateStackExpressions` from `@objectstack/lint` (control: the same node with a blank expression is refused); an authored filter is left alone and opening writes nothing (`onPatch` not called); not offered on another object, a non-record trigger, a node the start does not reach, or `delete_record` / `get_record`; Field values and Filter keys pick by label and store the API name; a stored unknown key shows as written and a typed one is taken; control: `create_record` keeps the text box.
- New `previews/FlowCanvas.updateRecordSeed-27834.test.tsx` (4 cases): the "+" on a record-triggered flow emits `update_record` with `config.objectName` = the trigger object, and the node parses against the spec's `FlowNodeSchema`; controls: a manual trigger seeds nothing, other node types seed what they did, a record trigger with no object seeds nothing.
- Updated pins: `FlowNodeInspector.fieldValueMap-11788` (its datalist case now runs `create_record` only; the not-a-field-value-map control moves from `update_record` filter to `delete_record` filter), `flowValueSlots-12372` (stubs `useObjectFields`, since the `update_record` filter now reads the object's fields), `flow-node-producers.label` (its scan control matches `defaultNodeExtras(type` now that the call passes the nodes).

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` on `85ec2c36`: Test Files 639 passed (639), Tests 6471 passed, 1 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0 (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, one leg per behaviour, app-shell tests import `src` so there is no dist leg; each leg restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - the target button's write replaced by a no-op: 1 failed / 13;
  - `pickKeys` forced false: 4 failed / 13;
  - the `update_record` seed returning nothing: 2 failed / 13.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The seed lives at node creation (`previews/flow-canvas-parts.tsx`, `FlowCanvas.tsx`), outside the claim's `inspectors/**` surface; the seat widened the surface to those two files before the edit.
- `create_record`'s Field values could take the same label picker by adding `byLabel: true` to its `FIELD_VALUE_MAPS` row; left out because the order keeps other node types unchanged.
- The target is offered only where `record` is in scope at the node, the same rule the reference picker uses, so a node not yet connected below Start does not offer it until it is.
- The hint and line name the object by its API name, as the sibling "Fields of …" hint does.

## Verification

Local derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands` on this diff) all exit 0; `ui` `check:new-line-citations` 0 new; `check:i18n-drift` 0 findings; `check:sdui-manifest` exit 0. CI runs the rest.
